messages:
priyanka: FYI nightly eval alert - vX.2 on `qa-structured` spike in JSON parse failures. failure_rate went from 0.9% -> 6.3% across 5k examples. anyone around? :eyes:
sam: on it, can you post a couple of raw example inputs + the model outputs (broken ones)?
priyanka: yep. attaching 2 quick reproducers below (from the nightly artifact). eval-bot posted run: https://ci.redwood/evals/2026-03-18/2320998765/artifacts
priyanka: Prompt:
```
{"task":"list_steps","input":"How to reset router and confirm connectivity"}
```
priyanka: Output (vX.1 good):
```
{"steps":["unplug power","wait 30s","plug in","check LED","run ping 8.8.8.8"]}
```
priyanka: Output (vX.2 flaky):
```
{"steps":["unplug power","wait 30s","","plug in","check LED"  
```
priyanka: notice the stray NUL and truncated closing bracket.
alex: hmm looks like premature EOS / token corruption. did we change tokenizer or quant profile in vX.2?
matt: we landed two changes in the rollout: tokenizer BPE table update (commit c3f2b) + switched default quant profile to int4-aggressive for hosted. both landed around 2026-03-17 22:40 UTC.
sam: ok plausible causes: (1) tokenizer conversion produced different offsets -> broken byte/utf8 boundaries in decode; (2) weight quantization causing new EOS token emission earlier. can we isolate?
priyanka: i ran a quick tokenization diff: `scripts/token-diff.py --left vX.1 --right vX.2 --input-file repro.txt` outputs a few examples where a single grapheme got split into extra subtokens in vX.2, e.g. 
```
left: [820, 1345, 67]
right: [820, 31, 129, 67]
```
priyanka: that could nudge generation to emit a raw 0x00? weird.
alex: not likely to emit NUL by itself; more likely decoding/byte-to-unicode mapping bug in tokenizer changes. matt, did the BPE table change include a new decoder map?
matt: yes we updated decoder table to follow upstream normalization fix. it's possible an edge-case map entry got malformed (I saw one weird entry in the vet script but assumed harmless).
sam: next steps proposal: (A) reproduce locally by running the model binary with vX.2 weights + vX.1 tokenizer and vice-versa. (B) re-run nightly eval with quant=int8 (no int4 profile) to see if quant affects failure rate. (C) run quick token-diff over the entire qa-structured seed set and compute KLD of token length distribution.
priyanka: doing (A) now. command I'm running: 
```
python eval_harness/run_promptset.py --model-dir /models/vX.2 --tokenizer /tokenizers/vX.1 --promptset qa-structured --out out_vX2_weights_vX1_tok.json
```
priyanka: also kicked a quick job to re-run nightly with int8: https://ci.redwood/job/2321000010 (ci-bot will post results)
ci-bot: Started rerun job id=2321000010 for nightly-eval with override quant=int8. ETA ~12m.
priyanka: local run (weights vX.2 + tok vX.1) produced valid JSON for the sample repro — no NUL, closing brackets present.
alex: that points strongly at tokenizer changes. good catch.
matt: i'll roll back the decoder-table patch for a staged canary and push a hotfix candidate (c3f2b-revert).
sam: i'll leave the nightly rerun (int8) and monitor failure_rate. if int8 reduces failures then quant interaction is contributing; otherwise tokenizer is main culprit.
priyanka: quick stat snapshot from initial failing run (eval-bot): overall parse_fail_count=315, parse_fail_rate=6.3%, most failures concentrated on templates where output contains nested JSON arrays.
priyanka: sample diff from token-diff for one bad example: 
```
input: "List steps to ..."
left tokens: [104, 22, 345, 90]
right tokens: [104, 22, 78, 267, 90]
right decoded substring: "\u0000" at pos 23
```
sam: interesting — the decoded substring shows a control char only in vX.2 decode. could be bad mapping table entry (matt).
matt: i'm pushing a patch to revert the decoder mapping and will run a quick canary. will post artifact when done.
priyanka: thanks. any guidance for customers hitting this? support-runbook?
alex: add a temporary note in status page: "We detected increased structured-output parse failures for vX.2 due to a tokenizer mapping issue; team investigating. If you need an immediate workaround, pin model version to vX.1 or use the runtime flag `--use-legacy-tokenizer`"
sam: CI job finished: ci-bot: nightly rerun (int8) completed. eval-bot: rerun results: parse_fail_rate=6.1% (marginal change).
sam: so quant likely not the main cause. tokenizer revert should fix.
matt: canary with revert is running: https://ci.redwood/canary/2321000060. if green, i'll promote hotfix to hosted and cut vX.2.1 with decoder fix and update release notes.
priyanka: will re-run the full qa-structured token-diff and post aggregated stats once canary completes. planning: triage doc + RCA draft after hotfix. owners: matt (hotfix), priyanka (repro & token-diff), sam (monitor & rollback plan), alex (status/statuspage).
matt: noted. ping me if you find more failing patterns (esp. non-ascii edge cases).
priyanka: thanks all. i'll update thread when canary artifacts are up. :white_check_mark:
